name: Norje Sunnansund fish fermentation and storage
description: A fish-rich pit at a forager settlement is interpreted as evidence for fermentation and storage of fish.

date.label: 9600–8600 calibrated years BP
date.basis: Source date for the documented context; BP conversion uses 1950 as reference where applicable.

events.statement: A fish-rich pit at a forager settlement is interpreted as evidence for fermentation and storage of fish.

evidence.supports: Norje Sunnansund is dated 9600–8600 calibrated BP; fish remains in a pit are interpreted as fermented and stored. The article reports 16,180 identified fish fragments across the site, not the catch size.

events.caveats: The preservation technique and storage duration are inferred from context; the dates cover the site rather than a precisely dated individual production cycle.

measures.conditions: Fragments identified to species or family across the site; only a portion of bones had been analysed and excavated, and this is not an estimate of the number of fish caught.
